description: Active in-stock simple product, searchable on the store, no required add-ons, with a price tier at or below quantityUsed on the guest's price list for the store (outputs the highest such tier, so the cart shows its price). KB: Custom Price Lists (Tier Price).

quantityUsed.description: Highest quantity the test may set; the tier output is the highest tier quantity at or below it (the test sets tierQuantity)

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
